name: activeScreen
label: Active Screen ID
description: ID of the current active screen

name: menuWidth
label: Max width the menu can grow.
description: Determines the max width the menu can grow before items start wrapping to new rows.

name: verticalStackingEnabled
label: Enable vertical stacking.
description: Enables vertical stacking of now-link-set links

name: edgeToEdge
label: Edge to Edge
description: Flag that determines whether menu should grow edge to edge of its width.
